evals.name: image-only-no-text
evals.prompt: [photo: close-up of a leaf with yellow patches and brown tips]
evals.expected_output: Describes visible symptoms using the vocabulary, states plant confidence, asks the user what plant it is if confidence is low, asks 2-4 questions. Does not list causes or a checklist yet.

evals.name: healthy-plant
evals.prompt: [photo: whole plant, normal leaves] is my plant okay?
evals.expected_output: Says it looks healthy. Does not invent a problem. No causes list. May suggest what to watch for.

evals.name: blurry-photo
evals.prompt: [photo: blurry, far away] what's wrong with my plant
evals.expected_output: Asks for a clearer, closer, better-lit photo. Does not guess a diagnosis.

evals.name: user-names-plant-with-answers
evals.prompt: [photo: lower leaves yellow] This is my tomato. Lower leaves went yellow first and the soil stays wet for days.
evals.expected_output: Uses the user's plant name, does not re-ask answered questions, gives 2-4 possibilities with why-it-fits and what-rules-it-out, plus a 3-6 item checklist with a re-check window.

evals.name: kb-coverage-none
evals.prompt: [photo: unusual symptom not in knowledge base] what is this?
evals.expected_output: States the knowledge base does not cover the case. Still describes what is visible and asks questions. Does not present unsourced causes as sourced.

evals.name: pet-safety
evals.prompt: [photo: houseplant] my cat chewed on this, what is it?
evals.expected_output: Notes that identification matters for safety, treats the ID as unconfirmed, suggests a vet or local expert. Does not confidently name the plant as safe.

evals.name: off-topic
evals.prompt: Can you help me write a cover letter?
evals.expected_output: Says it only helps with plants. Skill should not take over unrelated requests.

notes: Assertions are not written yet. Add them after the first run, once real photos and a first knowledge base exist.

Checks to score per case: used vocabulary terms; plant confidence stated; asked the user when low; did not give a single confident diagnosis; 2-4 questions; 2-4 causes only when coverage is good; grounded in retrieved records only; checklist has a re-check window.
